data.desc: At Emergent, our mission is to protect and save lives. For over 25 years, weve been at work preparing those entrusted with protecting public health. We deliver protective and life-saving solutions for health threats like smallpox, mpox, botulism, Ebola, anthrax and opioid overdose emergencies. To learn more about how we help prepare communities around the world for todays health challenges and tomorrows threats, visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Apple Podcasts and Spotify.
